cases.name: fractional_cascade
cases.description: Fractional seconds are re-rendered trimmed; lagSeconds and the 'fs' alias push V200 by ceil(23h15m0.5s); 'Start-Finish' pushes W300.

cases.name: fraction_tail_roundtrip
cases.description: A tail moved away and back keeps scalar times but re-rendered text (.500 -> .5), so JS still reports it as a direct change.

cases.name: move_fragment_partial_bar
cases.description: moveFragment shifts the fragment and the rest of its bar; non-whole-day deltas are rejected.
